description.value: Amberdo Cafe is a nature-inspired franchise cafe on West 4th Avenue in Kitsilano, one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors, offering premium espresso drinks, freshly baked pastries, and a savoury lunch menu. The interior uses wood, stone, and greenery to create a calm retreat from urban activity, and the cafe hosts community events including open mic nights and art exhibitions. With seven years of history and five active locations across the city, it has become a well-established neighbourhood hub.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from amberdo.ca is complete and confirms an active multi-location cafe franchise; the Kitsilano branch at 2678 West 4th Avenue is one of five active locations and the site was updated as recently as March 2026. The menu page details a full food and beverage offering including multiple plant-based savory and pastry items, but neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refills, or other cycle-specific amenities. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Amberdo Cafe and Bakery' while the website consistently uses 'Amberdo Cafe' with no 'and Bakery' suffix.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM tags the business as 'Amberdo Cafe and Bakery' but the website consistently brands it as 'Amberdo Cafe' with no 'and Bakery' suffix — OSM name may be outdated or incorrect.

This is a multi-location franchise; the OSM record and this listing refer specifically to the Kitsilano / West 4th Avenue branch. Other branches (North Vancouver, Burrard, West Georgia, etc.) may warrant separate OSM records.
